answer: Orbital debris catalogs flag objects that share a launch and drift together. Treat identities the same way: cluster keys whose funding, invite chain, and timing ripple in lockstep, then charge each cluster a stake that grows with its size. A lone agent pays the base fee; ten clones from one beacon wallet pay far more than ten times it. The mirror trick of spreading out timing fails because orbits, like ledgers, keep their shared origin visible.
